lead: The seven lessons gave you the pieces: hypothesis, experiment, promotion, lessons, binding rule, protected meter, and trace. What's left is putting them together in your system and checking that none was left out. This lesson also closes the track: what each of the six courses puts into the loop, and the dated plan to assemble yours.
objetivo: check the eight pieces of the loop that learns in your project, close what's missing, and close the track with the dated plan.

The whole track in six courses

secoes.legenda: conferir-loop.py reads loop.conf at the project root. It checks that the pieces are present and consistent, not the quality of your hypothesis.

secoes.sub: An empty folder and a loop assembled by the kit (montar.sh repeats, without a model, what lessons 1 to 7 did). It needs the loop-r and sil-loop-r repositories in ~/projetos.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-aprende-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-aprende/a8; rm -rf $E; mkdir -p $E/vazio
echo "## uma pasta sem nada"; python3 $K/conferir-loop.py $E/vazio > $E/vazio.txt; echo "saída: $?"; tail -1 $E/vazio.txt
echo "## as oito peças montadas pelo kit (o que as aulas 1 a 7 fizeram)"
bash $K/montar.sh $E/meu-loop > /dev/null
python3 $K/conferir-loop.py $E/meu-loop; echo "saída: $?"
echo "## o loop.conf que o conferir lê"; cat $E/meu-loop/loop.conf

# loop.conf — o que o conferir-loop.py lê (KEY=valor; ~ e $HOME valem). Fica na raiz do seu projeto.
SISTEMA=~/projetos/<seu-sistema>          # repo onde o experimento roda (tem results.tsv); padrão: esta pasta
LOOP=~/loops/<seu-loop>/promocao           # versoes/ + memoria/ledger.md (aula 3); fora do repo do sistema
GUARDA=~/loops/<seu-loop>/medidor.sha256   # manifesto do medidor (aula 6); fora do repo
ESCONDIDOS=~/loops/<seu-loop>/escondidos.jsonl
RASTRO=~/loops/<seu-loop>/rastros.jsonl    # uma linha por ciclo (aula 7)
TETO_TOKENS=<tokens por ciclo, a partir da sua medição real>
APROVADOR=<quem aprova a promoção (nível L1)>

What stays outside the system repo (meter, hidden cases, trace, versions) goes in a sibling folder: the agent that changes the system can't reach what judges it.

secoes.sub: What each course adds to your loop. This one is the last.

texto: The five pieces of the loop (goal, state, action, verification, stop), the harness, today's loop engines, LOOP-R and the done criterion from 0 to 4.
Whoever says it's done can't be whoever did it: skeptical evaluator, frozen tests, shortcuts, gold set, calibrated judge and the layered gate.
The seven-file kit, goal.md level 3+, context in bands, handoff that checks, headless loop with a ceiling and session measurement.
When not to use it, subagents with short returns, generator × evaluator, worktrees, queues without collisions and the Claude + Codex team.
Lethal trifecta, Rule of Two, injection through read content, permissions per step, guard hooks, sandbox and the door to the irreversible.
Hypothesis with a number, keep/discard, promotion and rollback, lessons that become a binding rule, protected meter and cost per cycle.

exercicios.titulo: E22 · From 0/8 to 8/8 in the rehearsal

exercicios.texto: In your project, copy loop.conf.exemplo to loop.conf, point each path to the pieces you built in the practice sections of lessons 1 to 7, and run conferir-loop.py. Close the missing pieces one at a time, in order.
With the loop at 8/8, run a real cycle with your agent, with the guardrail and hidden cases on and the trace recording. If it ends in keep, make the card and ask the person who decides for approval.
exercicios.pronto: your system's results.tsv gets a new line, the trace gets a line with tokens, and there is a decisao.md with a name and date if the cycle ended in keep.

resultado.titulo: At the end of the track
resultado.texto: A loop that works for hours, checks itself, runs safely, and improves with numbers: it changes, measures, keeps what gained, goes back when it gets worse, and remembers what it learned.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

perguntas.p: conferir-loop.py returned 8/8. What does that guarantee?
opcoes: That the next cycle will give keep
That the eight pieces exist and are wired together
perguntas.explica: It checks presence and consistency (files, links, hashes, the SIL check), not the quality of the choices.

perguntas.p: Why do the meter, hidden cases, trace, and versions stay outside the system's repo?
opcoes: So the agent that changes the system can't reach what judges it
Because git doesn't accept large JSONL files or symbolic links
perguntas.explica: It's the lesson from lesson 6 applied to the whole design: whoever does the work doesn't touch the judge.

perguntas.p: Which course in the track owns "separate evaluator, frozen tests, and calibrated judge"?
perguntas.explica: This course points there in lesson 6. Each topic has an owner in the track.

perguntas.p: In the map's order, why does "Protect" come before "Build"?
opcoes: Because it's easier and faster, and the plan generator needs that order
Because promoting without a protected meter means promoting the shortcut
perguntas.explica: A loop built with an open meter keeps as an improvement everything that raises the score, including memorizing and tampering with the cases.

itens.texto: The loop runs for hours with state outside the model, a cap, and a stop, and whoever says it's done is a gate the agent can't reach.
Subagents and queues only when they help; no session combines private data, untrusted content, and output to the outside.
Change one thing, measure, keep what won, roll back when it gets worse, and turn the error into a rule the next session reads.
